text: どっちの　キノコを　くれるんだい？

structure.jp: どっちの　キノコを

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken short form of のだ. It shows the speaker wants something explained or is explaining. くれるんだ = 'it is that you will give'.

patterns.name: 〜だい
patterns.explanation: だい at the end makes a friendly, casual question that goes with a question word like どっち. くれるんだい = 'will you give me?'
